name: Hind Aluminium Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Hind Aluminium Industries Ltd is in the business of Aluminium Products, Power, and Treasury Operations.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
HAIL is a part of the Associated Group. The business is carried out by its two companies viz. the flagship company, Hind Aluminium Industries Limited (HAIL), and Associated Aluminium 
Industries Private Limited. The co. is engaged in the manufacturing 
of Wire Rods & Conductors. It is also in the business of mining & 
power generation.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.43 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 24.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -62.2% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 6.47% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.14.0 Cr.
